who: Admins and staff of a partner institute
overview: An institute becomes a partner when ICR approves its company as one. From then on the company's admin, and any team member given a learning role, sees **Partner Institute** in their profile menu.

rules: A member's contact details show in full on plans that include them; otherwise they are partly hidden until you choose to reveal them.
Only the enquiries for your own institute are listed.

website: Publishing courses and batches, and sending a course for ICR's review. **Open console** on the app's Partner courses screen opens these website pages inside the app.
Enrolments, attendance registers and trainers' timetables.
The institute's plan and its payouts.
